name: Hidamari no Hana
source:
Kousaku is back to his hometown because he quit a job angrily. He is supposed to start working at a flower shop that his mother runs. However, the shop is changed to a herb and herb tea shop. His mother tells him to work as a shop manager from today. Kousaku's new life is started.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090304202336/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1003050]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
耕作一气之下辞掉工作，回到了故乡。他原本应该去母亲经营的花店工作，然而店铺已经改成了香草与花草茶专卖店。母亲告诉他，从今天起就由他担任店长。耕作的新生活就此开始。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090304202336/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1003050]Eroge Shop[/url]]
